_comment: Keys starting with _ are comments. Paths are relative to this file.
_contact: Optional URL or email added to the User-Agent; Wikipedia and some APIs throttle requests without one.
_plugins: Content packs: list modules under plugins (and their folder under plugin_paths unless pip-installed). See `xteink-daily sources`.

crosspoint._comment: keep_days: delete our editions older than this from the reader (0 = never). backfill_days: also deliver missed editions this many days back.

server._comment: public_url is how the readers reach this machine (LAN IP). token is optional; if set, OPDS clients use it as the password.

koreader._comment: copy_to: optional folder to copy editions into (Dropbox/Syncthing folder, mounted Kobo...). kosync: only used by the `kosync` command to check progress.

llm._comment: Optional. Used by sources that summarize or explain (needs `pip install anthropic` and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or `ant auth login`). provider: anthropic | none.
